draft.metaDescription: How to season cast iron cookware.
draft.intro: Seasoning is one of the most important things you can do for your cast iron pan. In this article we'll explore the process and why it matters.

sections.heading: What is seasoning
sections.body: Seasoning is polymerised oil bonded to the iron. It is what makes cast iron non-stick.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.body: Seasoning matters because it protects the pan and improves cooking. It is important to note that a well-seasoned pan will last for generations.

sections.heading: Getting started
sections.body: Once you understand seasoning, you can begin. The process is straightforward and rewarding.
